title: Cavalier King Charles Spaniel Puppy Application
intro: Thank you for your interest in our puppies. The application takes about ten minutes, and your answers are saved on this device as you go.
disclaimer: Completing this application does not guarantee a placement or obligate you to purchase a puppy. It helps us match the right puppy with the right family and ensures our dogs go to safe, loving forever homes.
thankYouTitle: Thank you for your interest in our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel puppies!
thankYouText: Please note: Completing this application does not guarantee a placement or obligate you to purchase a puppy. It helps us match the right puppy with the right family and ensures our dogs go to safe, loving forever homes.
sentMessage: Thank you! We have received your application and will get back to you within 48 hours. A confirmation has been sent to {email}. If you don't see it, please check your spam folder.
fallbackMessage: We could not send your application automatically. Please copy it and email it to braveheartcavaliers@gmail.com, or text it to Laura at 360-702-2367.
confirmationText: Thank you for your interest in our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel puppies! We have received your application and will get back to you within 48 hours.
privacyNote: Your information is kept private. We use it only to review your application and to get back to you about a puppy. We never sell or share it, and we will never use it for advertising, marketing, or any other purpose.
